name: PvP Balance
description:
PvP Balance provides a series of changes with the aim of making multiplayer games more balanced and interesting. It also adds or modifies several random map templates. PvP Balance is compatible with the following mods: Tides of War, Horn of the Abyss, Pavilion Town, Ruins Town, Heavenly Forge 2000. If any of these mods is enabled, additional balance changes are applied.

Detailed documentation is available at:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1XC-J8Wd4A5WDpNgcjcUpg4oIlSXehCxU/view?usp=sharing
author: Wnuki (main author), Kurek and Andruids (graphical assets), Warzyw (Brawl and Nowa Arena templates), Misiokles and Dydzio (revision and technical support)

1.1: Spells: slow effect fixed, Vampirism moved to water magic school, damage of Frost Ring and Fireball changed to 15 x SP, Fireball cost decreased at expert level.
Skills: Hexes unbanned, Intimidation reworked (-1 morale and 0/-1/-2 attack at basic/adv./expert lvl).
Heroes: Zam banned, Osir unbanned, Galuum - starts with Interference instead of Resistance, corrected starting armies for Shroo, Thyroc, Kreevion, Ghuri, Eurydis, Odetta, Verstan and Ash.

Artifacts: class changed to Minor for artifacts giving rare resources, Head of Legion, Arms of Legion, Ring of Vitality and Pendant of Second Sight. Frog of Sagacity banned, Shield Wand temporarily banned due to incorrect effect of the artifact.

Objects: Red Tower banned, new bank Demon Domain introduced, Golden Utopia buffed, guards of Experimental Shop changed back to Steel Golems, fixed Dragon Utopia generation on Dunes terrain, fixed generation of Sorceress Castle and re-balanced the object, unbanned Seminarium object, fixed generation of Ancient Lamps (zone limit increased to 20), Imp Cache value decreased to 1500, improved creature arrangement in Ruins object and slightly increased the reward.

Creatures: Palladin nerfed (it casts Prayer at adv. level instead of mass Prayer), decreased Templar growth from 2 to 1. God Scales specialty of Anubis Warriors nerfed, Priestess and Forest Witch specialties nerfed. AI value of several units from Ruins Town, Heavenly Forge 2k, Pavilion Town and Tides of War adjusted.
Added polish translation for the descriptions modified by PvP-Balance mod.
1.2: Demon Domain bank: decreased amount of Efreets obtained as reward from 6/9/12 to 5/8/10, corrected object mask.
1.2.1: Added submod RMG which doubles value of t4 and t5 spell scrolls.
Allowed crypt generation on Asphalt terrain.
1.2.2: Spint starting spell fixed - now he has Bless instead of Ice Bolt.
Fixed graphics of View Earth and View Air spells.
Shield Wand unbanned due to fixed mechanics of the artifact.
AI value of Lizardmen and Lizard Warriors adjusted according to Hota 1.7 update.
Summon Earth Elemental and Summon Fire Elemental adjusted according to HotA 1.7 update.
1.2.3: Temporarily banned Aura of Power spell due to broken mechanics.
Fixed amount of summoned Fire and Earth Elementals at advanced level due to VCMI not accepting fractional values.
Spells Vampirism, Intervention and Summon Ghost unlocked in mage guild.
Build order in Ruins fixed - no Fort required for Mage Guild.
Build order in Conflux fixed - upgrade of lvl1 dwelling requires only lvl1 horde building (same as in HotA).
1.2.4: Do not spawn empty banks on maps with very high treasure values (100k+)
1.2.5: Temporarily banned Hokori hero due to broken mechanics of Aura of Power spell.
Withdrew changes regarding Ruins Town build order due to update of the original town mod.
Golden Utopia buffed - 2 Rust Dragons instead of 1.
Modified specialty of Palladin creature - it casts now Destroy Undead at the beginning of the battle.
1.3: Fundamental reorganisation of mod structure and a lot of new content added.
1.3.2: Shortened submod paths to avoid exceeding max path length on Windows.
1.3.4: Modified Town Portal Rework submod - expert Earth Magic gives advanced Town Portal, expert Fire and Water give advanced Town Portal, expert Earth and expert Fire/Water give expert Town Portal.
Air Hat and Earth Hat do not allow to cast Town Portal, Fly and Dimension Door without expert magic.
Firebal Wand - cost of Fireball increased to 4 mana, compatibility with Basic and Extended Spell Balance submods. Icebolt Wand - cost of Icebolt increased to 3 mana.
Added component effects for Statue of Legion.
Horseshoe Lake, Demon Domain, Fortified Maze and Elderbrain - small modification extending the possible terrains / zone limit.
Dangerous Cave - maximum size gives +2 attack instead of Relic Artifact.
Dangerous Cabe - new graphics for Ogre Archmage by Exx and Kurek.
Allowed terrains for Control Spell Scrolls fixed.
Fixed the sprite of Pandora's Box.
Corrected AI values of Leprechauns, Nagas, Ghost Dragons, Red Dragons and Scorpicors in compliance with HotA 1.7.2.
New Pavilion - Vizier and Embalmer can now learn Air Magic.
Jebus One Hero - added Pavilion, Forge2k and Ruins compatibility for Logistics and Scouting at Hand submod

Vietnamese Diplomacy - fixed Hill Fort generation, optimized zone treasure layout with aim of more frequent creature dwellings in the starting zones and more single-guarded Dragon FLy Hives in transition zones, Binoculars and Phylacterium slightly nerfed, Transformation Altar added when Tides of War mod is enabled, Pandora's Boxes with Azure Dragon are limited to 10 per zone now.
1.3.5: Limit of heroes per player increased from 16 to 100
Elderbrain object: Alhoons now additionally cast Hypnotize after attack with the same power as Fangarms
Sorceress Castle object: monks removed from the guard composition to increase guard morale from -1 to 0. Rewards slightly nerfed.
Nanomedic building in Forge2k: hp regeneration bonus changed from 7xtier to 3xtier
Vampirism spell - effect slightly increased giving 15/20/25/30 percent of drained health on corresponding levels
Alhoons and Illithids - Hypnotize spell power and number of casts decreased (25HP per Illithid with one cast, 50HP per Alhoon with two casts)
Trytons and Abyssal Trythons: damage and cost increased, Trawl effect duration decreased from 3 to 1 turns
Disable Factory submod reworked - now it is correctly enabled by default
Jebus One Hero template: Conflux towns in the Desert Zone now do not influence value of Pandora's Boxes and Dwellings in other zones, treasure value ranges adjusted

Vietnamese Diplomacy template: Dungeon, Inferno and Necropolis cannot generate in the underground, cost of Transformation Altar use adjusted, T1-T4 creature Pandora's Boxes banned on the whole map, treasure density in the starting zones adjusted
1.3.7: Sprites of Horseshoe Lake, Fortified Maze, Elderbrain and Arcane Library reduced in size
Arcane Library can generate now on any terrain
Custom battlefields added for Fortified Maze and Dangerous Cave objects, battlefield updated for Elderbrain and Horseshoe Lake
Polish translation added (to be completed in the next update)
Added conflict of Brawl template from PvPTemplates submod with Brawl template from Warzyw Templates mod.
1.3.8: In submod Basic Faction Balance added triple Resource Silo income for all remaining factions except for unofficial Factory (may be added later).
1.3.9: Added conflict of Nowa Arena template from PvPTemplates submod with Nowa Arena template from Warzyw Templates mod.
Number of guards, guard layout and allowedTerrains optimized for banks Fortified Maze, Elderbrain and Treant Thicket.
Seminarium bank now gives Paladins instead of Templars as reward
1.4: Fundamental rework. PvP Balance now has simpler structure with less submods and customization on player's side. Only the most controversial balance changes are disabled by default. The mod does not longer require Horn of the Abyss mod.
